mapper.select: SELECT id, text, enabled, sort FROM slogans ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, text, enabled, sort FROM slogans WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, text, enabled, sort FROM slogans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT text FROM slogans WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO slogans (text, enabled, sort) VALUES (#{text}, 1, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort), 0) + 1 FROM slogans))
mapper.update: UPDATE slogans SET text = #{text} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE slogans SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
